first_public_date_basis: First arXiv public posting of the selected motivating Zhao–Yağan–Gligor paper on 2015-02-02. Huillet 2003 and Holst–Hüsler 1984 are older supporting literature, not assigned exact first-public day in this record.
integrity: Complete self-contained argument plus standalone Python finite check; no independent audit or external mathematical certificate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-size, uniform, one-dimensional circular hard threshold graph with fixed real window parameter only; no rate, higher-dimensional analogue or soft-edge extension. title: Joint Gaussian–Poisson decoupling at the circular isolation threshold
